item.title: What is the difference between phone restart and shutdown?
item.description: Confused about whether to restart or shut down your phone? A restart powers off and immediately reboots your device, clearing temporary memory and refreshing system processes automatically. Shutdown completely powers off your phone until you manually turn it back on. While both close apps and clear RAM, restart is better for weekly performance maintenance, resolving sluggishness and software glitches.
